title: Splitting stationary sets: Ulam matrices
summary: An Ulam matrix partitions every stationary subset of an infinite successor cardinal into as many stationary pieces as possible.
abstract: A stationary set meets every closed unbounded set of ordinals, yet it can be partitioned into many disjoint sets with the same property. At the first uncountable ordinal, every stationary set has uncountably many disjoint stationary pieces. More generally, at any infinite successor cardinal, the number of pieces can equal the size of the ambient cardinal. This is the largest possible number of nonempty pieces. None of these pieces contains a closed unbounded set, since such a set would have to meet every other stationary piece.
